name: Can I seal grout myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I seal grout myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY grout sealing products are available, hiring a professional often yields better and longer-lasting results. Professionals have access to commercial-grade sealants and specialized equipment for deep cleaning and precise application. They also have the experience to identify and address specific issues like stubborn stains or damaged grout before sealing. Improper DIY application can lead to uneven coverage, trapped dirt, or a cloudy finish, potentially requiring professional correction later. For optimal protection and appearance, especially for large or high-traffic areas, professional service is recommended.
